newsitem.title: USA: Microware sees Q3 loss, higher revenues.
newsitem.headline: Microware sees Q3 loss, higher revenues.

text.p: Microware Systems Corp said Monday it expects to report a net loss for its fiscal third quarter ended December 31, 1996 of between $0.03 and $0.04 a share compared with net income of $0.02 for the same quarter ended last year.
Revenue for the third quarter ended December 31, 1996, is estimated at $5.9 million, compared with $5.7 million for the same quarter ended last year, the company said in a statement.
Compared with the previous quarter ended September 30, 1996, there was a modest increase in product revenue and a significant decline in services revenue, Microware said.

Microware attributed the drop in services revenue to a transition from recently completed projects to new projects. Additionally, the company cited lower than expected product revenue to seasonal delays in the completion of new business, as well as customer delays in product roll-outs of new paging and network computing devices.

"While we are disappointed with our third quarter results, we are encouraged by new design wins in the wireless and embedded Internet markets, which we expect to jointly announce in the near future," said Ken Kaplan, president of Microware, in a statement.
Looking ahead, Kaplan said: "We are encouraged and optimistic about the outlook for a strong fourth quarter."
The company expects to report fiscal third quarter results on January 23, 1997.

Microware develops and markets real-time operating system software and development tools for advanced consumer communications and industrial products, including devices for the digital television, Internet and wireless communication markets.
